def transform(df):
    df['first_review'] = df.groupby('host_id')['last_review'].transform('min')
    df['second_review'] = df.groupby('host_id')['last_review'].transform('max')
    df.drop_duplicates(subset='host_id', keep='first', inplace=True)
    return df[df['last_review'] == df['first_review']]
